title: X9: Cross-device notification-spec changes are never reconciled

description: RemoteChangeReconciler filters to lastFiredAt changes only - spec inserts, spec deletes, and task soft-deletes made on another device leave local OS notifications wrong in BOTH directions. restoreSteadyState runs only during migration, never on ordinary sync. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 4, plan 4b notification-truthfulness. Sweep: cross-process.
